interpretation_limits: Small deterministic fixture panel and two seeds are not an optimal-sampler proof.
Initial code/arithmetic budget exhaustions remain reported; the matched supplement raises their budgets and batches one request from each temperature together.
Correctness after removing a JSON Markdown fence is separate from strict JSON-only formatting compliance.
The capped synthetic dossier batch does not reproduce the earlier 29k–96k native requests or prove their loop cause.
All samples use one shared MTP2 process; changes in age, scheduling and batch composition can affect results.
Varying completion lengths make elapsed time descriptive, not a fixed-work speed comparison.
Absence of detected repetition in this bounded panel does not establish a general repetition fix.

normalized_short_panel.description: All seven tasks at both seeds. Original arithmetic/code entries are replaced by their uniform 4096-token supplement with matched cross-temperature C4 batches; every other entry is unchanged. Initial outcomes are retained in phases.temperature. Batch composition differs from the initial panel.

ranking_rule.objective_answers: Twelve exact-answer or exact-tool checks across two seeds. Markdown fences do not change semantic correctness.
ranking_rule.completed_tasks: Finished before the fixed output cap; correctness is scored separately. Fourteen requests include two open designs.
ranking_rule.total_output_tokens: Sum of API usage.completion_tokens across the same 14 selected requests, including reasoning, visible content, tool output, and tokens spent on failures/capped responses.
ranking_rule.calibration_cost: Original budget-exhausted rows replaced by the matched supplement are retained in the research phases but are not double-counted in a condition.

selected_profile.selection_basis: Best observed objective accuracy/completion, lowest output cost among those tied leaders, and the highest blind creativity mean in this small panel.
selected_profile.capped_outcome_interpretation: The selected profile remains the overall choice from the matched quality/cost and blind creativity panel. Both selected and baseline profiles fail the strict capped correct-tool contract; this is retained as a limitation, not relabeled as a passed validation. The candidate also exhausts the code output budget.
selected_profile.optimality_claim: Best observed profile in this small panel, not a universal optimum or a proven repetition fix.
selected_profile.production_activation_owned_by: Root/backend agent; this experiment does not mutate defaults.
selected_profile.conditional_extension_reason: Temperature 1.2 did not win the requested quality/completion/output comparison.

capped-candidate.note: These read-only diagnostics do not change the failed tool-call assessment. The deployment prompt asks for an order but does not explicitly require an array; a correct letter string is a representation ambiguity rather than a demonstrated factual error. No fixture or sampling input was changed.

capped-baseline.note: These read-only diagnostics do not change the failed tool-call assessment. The deployment prompt asks for an order but does not explicitly require an array; a correct letter string is a representation ambiguity rather than a demonstrated factual error. No fixture or sampling input was changed.

blind_creativity_review.scale: Each criterion is scored independently from 0 to 4; totals are out of 16.
blind_creativity_review.grading_note: Qualitative blind judgment, not an objective benchmark or statistical estimate. Originality has been finalized relative to all eighteen supplied answers. Earlier individual evidence is preserved verbatim from its review stage, including any references to the smaller comparison set then available. These are assessed as 350–450-word capability sketches, not full implementation specifications. No external novelty search or empirical validation was performed; condition mappings and generation logs were not accessed.

originality_finalization.note: No provisional originality adjustment was warranted by the completed comparison. Scores of 2 reflect modest substantive variation within this batch, not a claim of external novelty; the other answers remain at 1.

blind_creativity_review.interpretation: Modest variation among useful sketches; no originality score exceeds 2/4. Two samples and one blind qualitative reviewer do not establish a universal creativity optimum.

visible_design_review.observation: Both are coherent. Temperature 1.0 gives an explicit exponential-backoff formula and clearer in-flight cancellation limits; 0.6 explicitly records every transition and tests the payment-success/crash boundary more directly.
visible_design_review.conclusion: No universal quality winner from one example; no observed readability collapse at 1.0. This is qualitative evidence, not a creativity score.

temperature_1_2_review.seed_29: Coherent and explicitly reuses the same payment idempotency key.
temperature_1_2_review.seed_17: Weaker than the reviewed 1.0 answer: categorically calls payment irreversible without support; the audit section says to check the API or log rather than explicitly retry with the same idempotency key.
temperature_1_2_review.conclusion: Mixed qualitative quality. Passing headings and word count does not establish semantic correctness or a general improvement.
